title: Aerial Infrared Health Monitoring of Solar Photovoltaic Farms at Scale
mechanism: Cascade of table segmentation, oriented panel detection and anomaly detection, plus a max-minus-median sub-grid rule for hot spots with five delta-T severity bands.
evidence: R (full text read): >6,000 US farms, 2.2 to 6.5 cm GSD; table U-Net mIoU 97.9; rotated Faster R-CNN mAP@75 83.3; YOLOv5-L P@50 89.8; hot spot = >5 C above neighbours, bands up to >= 15 C. Data private.
adaptation: Blueprint for the drone thermal deliverable; the physically defined banded severity output is a template for an EL severity layer (inactive area fraction bands per cell, crack mode).
min_experiment: CPU: define EL severity bands from predicted inactive fraction per cell, check agreement with ground-truth bands on val (weighted kappa); kill the band scheme if kappa < 0.6.
